title: Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data

entities.name: Unknown protocol data
entities.description: Protocol data that is not recognized or understood by the receiver.

entities.name: Unforeseen protocol data
entities.description: Protocol data that is not anticipated by the current specification version.

entities.name: Erroneous protocol data
entities.description: Protocol data that contains errors or inconsistencies.

entities.name: Protocol data handling procedure
entities.description: General procedure for handling unknown, unforeseen, or erroneous protocol data.

relations.description: The handling procedure applies when unknown protocol data is encountered.
The handling procedure applies when unforeseen protocol data is encountered.
The handling procedure applies when erroneous protocol data is encountered.
